headline: Sensex and Nifty open negative on October 27 despite previous recovery; HDFC Bank announces CEO transition

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty 50 started in the negative during pre-open trade on October 27
Global oil prices are trading below $115 per barrel
Markets snapped a four-day losing streak in the previous session driven by value buying
Investors are reacting to a major leadership transition at HDFC Bank
whatHappening: HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan is exiting as Anup Bagchi takes charge of the private lender
Mankind Pharma is seeing a sharp rise in futures open interest in the F&O segment
JP Morgan Asset Management's fixed income head has identified the bond market as a buy
IPO grey market premiums are being monitored for EAAA India, BLS Polymers, and SFC Environmental
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened lower on October 27 after a recovery session that saw the Sensex gain 480 points. HDFC Bank is in focus following the announcement that Anup Bagchi will succeed Sashidhar Jagdishan as CEO. Market participants are also tracking Mankind Pharma's F&O activity and global oil price movements.
